# My Teacher Is an Alien Archipelago v0.1.0

**First Public Beta Release**

*My Teacher Is an Alien* is a point and click adventure from 1997. In this game, you play as Peter, Susan, and Duncan to try and uncover the alien in your school, rescue your friends who have been kidnapped, and try to stop an alien invasion. 

## This game features

- **Randomized inventory items**, including investigation equipment, evidence, and other useful items.
- **Progressive Periods**, allowing additional school periods to become available as you collect progression items.
- **Character Unlocks**, allowing Peter, Susan, and Duncan to be unlocked through Archipelago.
- **Configurable starting character:** Choose one of the three to start with, have it picked at random, or start with all of them.
- **Five victory conditions:** Choose between any ending, a specific character's ending, or force yourself to complete all three.
- **Optional Full Ending requirement**, which means you need to save all six of your friends in each ending you are required to complete.

## Downloads

Download all three files from the Assets section of this release:

**1. `MTIAA-Installer.zip`**
**2. `mtiaa.apworld`**
**3. `My_Teacher_is_an_Alien.dxw`**

## Requirements

- A copy of *My Teacher Is an Alien* (1997)
- Archipelago 0.6.7 or newer
- [DxWnd](https://sourceforge.net/projects/dxwnd/files/latest/download)
- The three release files listed above

## Installation and Setup

For detailed installation instructions, DxWnd configuration, gameplay setup, and troubleshooting, see the [MTIAA Setup Guide](https://github.com/JasonArilani/Archipelago/blob/my-teacher-is-an-alien/worlds/mtiaa/docs/setup_en.md).

## Important Gameplay Information

MTIAA is designed to support multiple playthroughs of the school week within a single Archipelago seed.

You may need to start a New Game or load an earlier save to access certain locations, perform different investigations, or complete multiple character endings. Previously completed Archipelago locations and received items remain associated with your seed. 

**A few things to remember:**

- The original game's detention, suspension, and Game Over conditions still apply.
- Some investigation checks require performing actions across different school weeks.
- The alien teacher is randomized by the original game when starting a new school week.
- Save regularly. Separate saves are recommended for different seeds or player slots.
- Close the game before switching to a different Archipelago room or seed.

The Setup Guide includes explanations for common Game Over conditions and other gameplay situations.

## Beta Status and Feedback

The randomizer has undergone testing of its progression logic, character endings, item delivery, location checks, and client integration including several complete seeds. However, unexpected issues may still occur, particularly involving unusual story sequences, repeated playthroughs, saves, or interactions between randomized items and the original game's scripting.

If you encounter a bug, or if you have any feedback on the beta release of this randomizer, please let me know.

## Credits

**Original game:** *My Teacher Is an Alien* (1997), by 7th Level / Byron Preiss Multimedia.
**Game source reconstruction:** [neuromancer/my-teacher-is-an-alien-re](https://github.com/neuromancer/my-teacher-is-an-alien-re). This integration builds upon the reconstructed game source.

**AI Disclosure:** This project was developed with the aid of ChatGPT (Open AI). AI was used to analyze the code from the base game, the reconstructed game, and assist with writing the code to patch the game and create the Archipelago files. I tested the code extensively and provided much of my own personal experience with the game to ensure that the logic followed what was needed for the game to run. This was done in collaboration with ChatGPT, not just given to ChatGPT to create. I take full responsibility for the code included in this integration.
